faillock.description: Enable PAM faillock-based account lockout after failed login attempts. Configure thresholds and unlock delay.

deny.description: Number of failed attempts before lockout

unlock_time.description: Seconds before automatic unlock (0 = manual unlock only)

tally2.description: Enable legacy pam_tally2-based lockout (for older systems). Prefer faillock if available.

audit_rules.description: List of audit/access control rules for login (e.g., restrict login to specific users).

items.description: Define an audit rule for login access control.

condition.description: If true, use [success=done default=bad] branching instead of unconditional 'required'

users.description: List of usernames *not* allowed to login (i.e., deny these users)
